dna.sounds: Gentle waves, distant seabirds, dripping water, creaking metal

7be61065-eb6a-4393-b31e-dd77f59614e9.description: A multi-pod structure emerging from clear, shallow turquoise ocean waters under a hazy, bright sky. The unusual building consists of several interconnected, spherical and cylindrical modules, predominantly rusted in shades of faded orange-red and mottled off-white, with significant patches of green moss and algae growing across its flat surfaces and crevices. Multiple circular openings serve as windows or entrances. The base of the structure rests on a rocky foundation, partially submerged, with various underwater rocks and patches of dark green seaweed clearly visible through the transparent water. A rusted metal ladder extends from one of the lower pods directly into the calm sea.
7be61065-eb6a-4393-b31e-dd77f59614e9.searchDesc: Weathered multi-pod structure in shallow turquoise water, encrusted with moss and algae.
